name: Celestial Patron

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

summary: A pact with a being of the Upper Planes: healing light, radiant magic and resilience for you and your friends.

feature.name: Celestial Spells
feature.summary: Aid, Cure Wounds, Guiding Bolt, Lesser Restoration, Light and Sacred Flame always prepared; more at levels 5, 7 and 9.
feature.text: When you reach a Warlock level shown, you always have these spells prepared; they don't count against your Prepared Spells: Aid, Cure Wounds, Guiding Bolt, Lesser Restoration, Light and Sacred Flame (3); Daylight and Revivify (5); Guardian of Faith and Wall of Fire (7); Greater Restoration and Summon Celestial (9).

feature.name: Healing Light
feature.summary: A pool of d6s (1 + Warlock level); as a Bonus Action spend up to Charisma-modifier dice to heal a creature within 60 feet.
feature.text: You have a pool of d6s equal to 1 plus your Warlock level, refilled on a Long Rest. As a Bonus Action you can heal yourself or one creature you can see within 60 feet by expending dice from the pool, at most a number equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum one) at a time; roll them and the creature regains that many Hit Points.

feature.name: Radiant Soul
feature.summary: Resistance to Radiant damage; once per turn add your Charisma modifier to a spell's Radiant or Fire damage against one target.
feature.text: You have Resistance to Radiant damage. Once per turn, when a spell you cast deals Radiant or Fire damage, you can add your Charisma modifier to that spell's damage against one of its targets. The Resistance is applied; the damage bonus waits for the combat engine.

feature.name: Celestial Resilience
feature.summary: After a Short or Long Rest gain Temporary Hit Points (Warlock level + Charisma) and share some with up to five creatures.

feature.name: Searing Vengeance
feature.summary: Once per Long Rest, when an ally near you makes a Death Saving Throw, restore it to half its Hit Points in a burst of Radiant damage.
